\section[o despertador]{o despertador — an alarm clock}

\label{lesson:PT-C100-despertador}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: o despertador}
\textbf{o despertador} — \textquotedblleft{}an alarm clock\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{despertador} is \textquotedblleft{}the waker\textquotedblright{}: built from the verb \textquotedblleft{}to wake up\textquotedblright{} and \emph{-dor}, \textquotedblleft{}one that does\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB 2.1).
\end{cousinweb}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: o telemóvel}
